caption:
Stop fighting weird fonts and colors when you paste. ⌨️

Windows: Ctrl + Shift + V
Mac: Command + Shift + V (works in most apps)

It pastes the text only, matching the place you paste into. In Word on Mac, use the Paste Options button instead.
